name: feasible-corridor-dev-v4
hypothesis: Hold the prior obstacle side when a continuously tracked obstacle jitters across the estimated road center by at most one pixel and no full corridor is feasible. Retaining the v2 no-corridor speed cap of 18 and the observed-road row42 correction may recover the v3 on-road stall and late repeated collision without changing clear-road or proven-corridor behavior.
candidate_source_construction: Read the normalized committed Git blob bytes of agent.py at c366022 (SHA256 e43c33171e1247cc1b2c6c51f9ccbbc1f775ee033b8651c74a1f686ed7911396; 165515 bytes). Replace the sole byte sequence '_CompoundClearingBrakeCarryController()' with '_FeasibleCorridorTemporalSideController()'; resulting snapshot SHA256 db7037862230c48cc9641b9042e1fd7758747a55aaf3d1f5b5fbabb41c97ac44. The active Agent route remains the baseline.
evaluation_budget: Reuse exactly the same 55 already consumed paired cells and fixed ten-cell mechanism triage as v1-v3; no new geometry is exposed during development. Reuse the 32 frozen ego-screen controls only after source/environment/receipt checks; cold-run the older 23 controls and all 55 v4 candidates if full expansion is unlocked. First run 20 fixed triage rows (18 new cold workers, two reused controls). Full55 is mandatory-gated on the matching complete20-row triage summary: no lost baseline finish, no new crash DNF, no paired both-DNF progress decline, no operational/receipt/hash failure, and at least one changed candidate action trace. Report contact/damage/time deltas; the full comparison decision and fresh-study design must account for them. No repeats count as independent geometry samples.
decision_rule: This is consumed development evidence only. Compare v4 to the active baseline on actual Agent-route finish, progress, completed-lap time, per-cell contacts/damage, and source-bound comparison decision. Keep all v1-v3 hard-veto cells in the fixed triage; no selective exclusions. A passing triage permits only the remaining consumed55 comparison. Any favorable full result can justify separately preregistered fresh screen, confirmation and blind; never direct activation or SOTA promotion.
limits: The55 pairs comprise19 distinct geometry seeds, all previously consumed by v1-v3 or older screens. The v3 hard-veto cells and shared-finish delay motivated this narrow temporal switch diagnostic. Repeated development on these cells risks overfitting. No development outcome is evidence of unseen-track generalization. Earlier confirmation/blind seeds remain sealed; no protocol permits using them here.
